prompt: Objective: find why a software company's margin fell from 20% to 8%. What you've learned: revenue grew 25%. Latest finding: headcount grew 60%, mostly in sales. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check how fast revenue grew in more detail
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Compare revenue per salesperson before and after the hiring
options.feedback: Right. Sales hiring outran revenue. Productivity per salesperson tells whether the new hires are paying off.

options.text: Look at the company's office locations for more context on the business
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.

options.text: Recommend laying off 30% of the sales team
options.feedback: That jumps to a solution before the analysis supports it.

explanation: Sales hiring outran revenue. Productivity per salesperson tells whether the new hires are paying off.
